## Learning path

A concise collection of reusable design and fabrication lessons, projects, and classroom tools.

::: {.ter-path-grid}
::: {.ter-path-card}
### Culture & Land-Based Learning

Begin with place, community knowledge, seasonal observation, and respectful use of sources before turning an idea into a design.

[Open Culture & Land-Based Learning](culture-land-based-learning/index.qmd)
:::

::: {.ter-path-card}
### 1. N.I.C.E. Design Process

Find a need. Study the problem. Show your idea. Test it. Improve it.

[Open the design process](design-process/index.qmd)
:::

::: {.ter-path-card}
### 2. Logo Design

Learn the tools before making a physical project.

1. [Photopea Lesson 1: Build the Nameplate Text](logo-design/01-nameplate-text-photopea.qmd)
2. [Photopea Lesson 2: Trace a Rough Logo](logo-design/rough-sketch-to-svg-photopea.qmd)
3. [Photopea Lesson 3: Combine the Logo and Nameplate](logo-design/03-combine-logo-nameplate.qmd)
4. [Your Turn: Design Your Own Name + Logo Name Tag](03-laser-cutting/01-name-logo.qmd)
5. [Raster, Vector, and SVG](02-digital-design/01-raster-vector-svg.qmd)
6. [2D Animation with Pencil2D](02-digital-design/05-animation-ui-ux.qmd)
:::

::: {.ter-path-card}
### 3. Name Tag Laser Cutting

After your teacher approves your original design, use the file to prepare, make, and check the real wood part.

[Open the laser-cutting pathway](03-laser-cutting/index.qmd)
:::

::: {.ter-path-card}
### 4. Tool Organizer Project

After the name tag, use measurement, testing, and revision in larger projects.

[Open the tool organizer project](laser-cutting/tool-organizer.qmd)
:::

::: {.ter-path-card}
### Accessible Design

Choose readable fonts, zoom out to test clarity, use strong contrast, and make meaning work without colour alone.

[Open Accessible Design](accessible-design/index.qmd)
:::
:::

## Fabrication tools

- [Fabrication Plate Builder](tools/plate-builder/index.qmd) creates plates, rings, and repeated holder holes.
- [Laser-Cut Leg & Support Builder](tools/leg-builder/index.qmd) creates legs, stands, triangular supports, and the wide single easel back.
- [Tool Organizer Gallery](tools/tool-organizer-gallery/index.qmd) shows organizer examples, construction ideas, drawings, and downloads.
- [Laser-Cutting Files and Resources](../teaching-materials/laser-cutting/index.qmd) collects downloadable files and classroom resources.
